items.title: GenRecs Tokenization: Transforming Ads Recommendation at Meta with Stable Model Vocabulary
items.excerpt: Meta's generative recommenders now represent each ad, product or page as a short sequence of discrete codes derived from multimodal embeddings instead of a per-item ID, so new and low-engagement ads borrow signal from similar items. Paired with GEM and the Adaptive Ranking Model, Meta says it lifted advertiser conversions 0.35% across surfaces.
items.off_list_note: engineering.fb.com is Meta first-party (about.fb.com is allowed). Distinct from the 10-15 GEM 18.9% story and the 10-13 inference-capacity post.

items.title: TikTok Turns to Shoplazza to Power Agentic Commerce Offering
items.excerpt: Shoplazza is TikTok's commerce and payment partner for Buy Direct, which lets shoppers buy from brands inside TikTok over the Universal Commerce Protocol with the brand as merchant of record, and for the AI Shopping Assistant, which answers product questions from merchant page data. The pitch to merchants is a shorter path from content and ads to purchase.
items.off_list_note: Off-list (pymnts.com): no allowed-domain outlet covered it. Weaker pick: Buy Direct and Shopping Assistant came out earlier; the new part is the Shoplazza partnership. TikTok's 10-07 advertiser AI update is already in the ledger.
